## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Affected controls

List all `PRC-*` IDs. For structural, tooling, or guide-only changes, write “None.”

## Evidence and references

Explain how the wording or behavior was verified. Link primary sources for standards-dependent changes.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate.py`.
- [ ] I built the documentation with `mkdocs build --strict` when rendering or navigation changed.
- [ ] I did not renumber or reuse an existing control ID.
- [ ] I preserved technology-neutral wording or explained why specificity is required.
- [ ] I checked links and reviewed the rendered Markdown.
- [ ] I included no credentials, personal data, confidential evidence, or unsafe commands.

## Compatibility and migration

Describe any effect on existing assessments, evidence records, links, automation, or control mappings.
